arxiv-2012-10729.title: Universality in microdroplet nucleation during solvent exchange in Hele-Shaw like channels
arxiv-2012-10729.creator: Yanshen Li, 1 Kai Leong Chong, 1 Hanieh Bazyar, 2,3 Rob G. H. Lammertink, 2, Detlef Lohse, 1,4
arxiv-2012-10729.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yanshen Li, 1 Kai Leong Chong, 1 Hanieh Bazyar, 2,3 Rob G. H. Lammertink, 2, Detlef Lohse, 1,4. Micro and nanodroplets have many important applications such as in drug delivery, liquid-liquid extraction, nanomaterial synthesis and cosmetics. A commonly used method to generate a large number of micro or nanodroplets in one simple step is solvent exchange (also called nanoprecipitation), in which a good solvent of the droplet phase is displaced by a poor one, generating an oversaturation pulse that leads to droplet nucleation.

arxiv-2402-01063.title: Dracula’s Chivito: discovery of a large edge-on protoplanetary disk with Pan-STARRS
arxiv-2402-01063.creator: Ciprian T. Berghea, Ammar Bayyari, Michael L. Sitko, Jeremy J. Drake, Ana Mosquera, Cecilia Garraffo, Thomas Petit, Ray W. Russell, Korash D. Assani
arxiv-2402-01063.description: Abstract We report the serendipitous discovery of a large edge-on protoplanetary disk in Pan-STARRS (PS1) images. PS1 has five broadband filters designated as g P1 , r P1 , i P1 , z P1 , y P1 (hereafter g ​ r ​ i ​ z ​ y grizy ) with mean wavelengths 4866, 6215, 7545, 8679 and 9633 Å, respectively.

arxiv-2407-15746.title: Complementation in continuous cohomology with coefficients in Banach modules
arxiv-2407-15746.creator: Mario Klisse
arxiv-2407-15746.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Mario Klisse. In this article, we introduce the concept of weakly uniquely stationary representations. This framework enables us to investigate the complementability of closed subspaces within the context of continuous cohomology with coefficients in Banach modules. As an application, we extend and refine several cohomological results from the literature, particularly in the settings of nilpotent groups, products of groups, and lattices.

arxiv-2412-17900.title: Unraveling the generalized Bergshoeff-de Roo identification
arxiv-2412-17900.creator: Achilleas Gitsis, and Falk Hassler
arxiv-2412-17900.description: Abstract We revisit duality-covariant higher-derivative corrections which arise from the generalized Bergshoeff-de Roo (gBdR) identification, a prescription that gives rise to a two parameter family of α ′ \alpha^{\prime} -corrections to the low-energy effective action of the bosonic and the heterotic string.

arxiv-2511-20508.title: Causal Feature Selection for Weather-Driven Residential Load Forecasting
arxiv-2511-20508.creator: Elise Zhang 1 , François Mirallès 2 , Stéphane Dellacherie 3 4 , Di Wu 1 , Benoit Boulet 1
arxiv-2511-20508.description: Abstract Weather is a dominant external driver of residential electricity demand, but adding many meteorological covariates can inflate model complexity and may even impair accuracy. Selecting appropriate exogenous features is non-trivial and calls for a principled selection framework, given the direct operational implications for day-to-day planning and reliability.

pmc-11320059.title: Ni–Sr/TiZr for H2 from methane via POM: Sr loading & optimization†
pmc-11320059.creator: Norah Alwadai, Abdulaziz A. M. Abahussain, Dharmesh M. Vadodariya, Khaled M. Banabdwin, Anis Hamza Fakeeha, Jehad K. Abu-Dahrieh, Naif S. Almuqati, Ahmad M. Alghamdi, Rawesh Kumar, Ahmed S. Al-Fatesh
pmc-11320059.description: Achieving remarkable H2 yield with significantly high H2/CO over Ni-based catalysts through partial oxidation of methane (POM) is a realistic approach to depleting the concentration of CH4 and using H2 and CO as synthetic feedstock. This study examined Ni catalysts on titania–zirconia for methane conversion via POM at 600 °C and atmospheric pressure.

pmc-11575028.title: Global longitudinal strain manually measured from mid-myocardial lengths is a reliable alternative to speckle tracking global longitudinal strain
pmc-11575028.creator: Chee Cheen Yeong, Danielle L Harrop, Arnold C T Ng, William Y S Wang
pmc-11575028.description: BackgroundGlobal longitudinal strain (GLS) is a useful marker for the echocardiographic evaluation of left ventricular (LV) systolic dysfunction. Presently GLS is derived from speckle tracking of LV images, but speckle tracking software is not always available. We seek to determine if manually measured GLS (MM-GLS) by assessing mid-myocardial lengths can be a reliable alternative to speckle tracking GLS (ST-GLS).

pmc-12396196.title: Modified surgical procedure of corpus callosotomy: rostral corpus callosotomy via the transfrontal approach in dogs
pmc-12396196.creator: Daisuke Hasegawa, Rikako Asada, Takayuki Miura
pmc-12396196.description: Corpus callosotomy (CC) is a surgical procedure for palliative epilepsy surgery targeting generalized seizures. In humans, total CC (TCC) is primarily performed in pediatric patients, whereas anterior CC is typically performed in adult patients to avoid postoperative disconnection (split-brain) syndrome, even though the antiseizure effect is inferior to TCC.

pmc-12557131.title: Patient safety culture in Italian nursing homes: staff perceptions and key dimensional factors
pmc-12557131.creator: I Tocco Tussardi, S Tardivo, M A Mazzi, M Rimondini, D Visentin, E Torri, F Moretti
pmc-12557131.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundNursing homes (NHs) play an essential role in the care of the elderly and vulnerable, with an increasing demand for such services. Despite their importance, research on patient safety culture (PSC) in NHs is limited, particularly in European settings. This study investigates PSC among NH staff in a northern Italian region and explores how various PSC dimensions shape overall perceptions of patient safety (PS).MethodsA cross-sectional study was conducted with the staff from 25 NHs, yielding a 59% response rate.

pmc-12819901.title: A rare case of mixed tumor of the elbow mimicking sarcoma in radiology: a diagnostic challenge
pmc-12819901.creator: Jiro Ichikawa, Tomonori Kawasaki, Kojiro Onohara, Masanori Wako, Tetsuo Hagino, Satoshi Ochiai, Tetsuhiro Hagino, Hirotaka Haro
pmc-12819901.description: The occurrence of mixed tumors in soft tissues or myoepithelial tumors is extremely rare. Herein, we report a case of a mixed tumor suspected to be a sarcoma based on imaging findings. A 64-year-old male was admitted to our hospital with a mass that had been present for 10 years and had gradually increased in size, prompting medical attention.

pmc-12969620.title: Predictors of Higher Mavacamten Maintenance Dose in Obstructive Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
pmc-12969620.creator: Mustafa Suppah, Humam Abo Abdullah, Amro Badr, Ramzi Ibrahim, Juan Farina, Chadi Ayoub, Reza Arsanjani, Jeffrey Geske, Said Alsidawi
pmc-12969620.description: Mavacamten has emerged as an effective therapy for obstructive hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (oHCM); however, interindividual variability in maintenance dosing remains a practical challenge in clinical practice. We conducted a multicenter retrospective study of adults with oHCM treated with mavacamten across 3 tertiary sites to identify baseline predictors of higher maintenance dose requirements.

pmc-13324628.title: Impact of 3D model quality on user experience in mobile augmented reality applications
pmc-13324628.creator: Rafał Kaźmierczak, Paweł Dąbrowski, Robert Skowroński, Romuald Obuchovski, Jūratė Sužiedelytė-Visockienė, Paweł Burdziakowski, Jakub Szulwic
pmc-13324628.description: This paper explores the impact of 3D model quality on user perception in augmented reality (AR), using the visualization of Gediminas’ Tower in Vilnius as a case study. The research evaluates the relationship between polygon count, texture resolution, and user experience, focusing on visual realism, performance, and user satisfaction.

pmc-13599781.title: Apatinib monotherapy for pretreated advanced squamous cell carcinoma of the penis: a phase 2 trial
pmc-13599781.creator: Juan Zhou, Wenfeng Li, Mingjuan Sun, Sheng Zhang
pmc-13599781.description: BackgroundTreatment options for patients with advanced penile squamous cell carcinoma who have disease progression on systemic chemotherapy are scarce. Antiangiogenic drugs have shown antitumor effects in case series. This phase 2 trial evaluated the activity and safety of apatinib (a Vascular Endothelial Growth Factor (VEGF) receptor inhibitor) in such patients.

pmc-13619308.title: “There for the safety net, not the dreams”: local decision-makers’ perceptions on scarcity, trade-offs, and caregiving responsibilities in social care resource allocation in the Netherlands
pmc-13619308.creator: Philipa Mos, Vivian Reckers-Droog, Jennifer Baumbusch
pmc-13619308.description: Background and ObjectivesIn the Netherlands, municipalities are responsible for providing social care to enable older individuals to age in place. Resources are largely allocated by local decision-makers who translate policy into individual-level decisions, yet little is known about how they interpret and weigh relevant considerations in practice.
